decisions.reason: The address autocomplete web service builds directly on the firm's long-built address and master-data databases and its web service infrastructure, so its in-house R&D and data know-how let it interpret results and keep improving the service.

The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the firm's core grid-fee database expertise to a neighbouring regulated market, which it can assimilate well, though the foreign market adds some uncertainty.
Determining peak load windows is a regulated calculation task close to the firm's analytical core for network operators, so related knowledge and own R&D strongly support keeping it.
The end-customer tariff database fits the firm's market data business and its customer base of suppliers, making it easy to maintain and develop.
Custom web services draw on the firm's software development and data center capabilities and match its move toward a platform model, so they are likely to stay.
The postal code lookup service is a low-cost extension of the firm's established geographic master data, and it complements its other web services.
